required_facts.fact: Alder is 210 km, $38k upfront, and $4.2k estimated annual energy cost
Birch is 240 km, $44k upfront, and $3.9k estimated annual energy cost
Cedar is 190 km, $35k upfront, and $4.5k estimated annual energy cost
Dogwood is 220 km, $47k upfront, and $3.8k estimated annual energy cost
Annual energy estimates assume 18,000 km of service per vehicle; maintenance and charging infrastructure are excluded
Alder is the lowest-upfront-cost option among the options meeting the 200 km minimum

disallowed_claims: Alder is the lowest-cost option on every cost measure.
Annual energy cost includes maintenance or charging-infrastructure costs.
acceptable_choices: A shared-alignment comparison is appropriate because the options use the same criteria and the audience must compare alternatives.
The comparison may emphasize the range threshold or mark the qualifying options, provided all options and values remain available for comparison.
The brief does not prescribe a chart type; a table is also acceptable if legible and complete.
